Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Billing preference: For pilots that run over $10k we generally do a PO. Smaller pilots we charge on a company card. For ongoing committed capacity (Dedicated) procurement will push for PO/contracted billing.
- Marketplace: we'd be open to AWS Marketplace but that requires vendor onboarding (security questionnaires, tax forms) and adds ~2–3 weeks.
- Procurement contacts: procurement@acme.com is our centralized team for vendor onboarding. For approvals the chain is: Finance (Ravi Patel, Director of Finance) -> Legal (Maya Chen) -> VP (Taylor Nguyen) sign-off if the spend is above team budget. For this pilot, Taylor is the budget owner (data platform) and Ravi will be the finance sponsor.
- Timeline: procurement review + security questionnaire turnaround is typically 2 weeks if we get attachments and SOC reports quickly.

I'll copy procurement@acme.com on the next message and they can request any templates. We can do Tue 11:30am PT to review the SOW and next steps.
